title: box_refine v2: 'size' mode (position = tracker row, only log w / log h through One Euro) - pre-registration
written: 2026-11-15, before any v2 number on val-A or val-B was computed (the v1 numbers of results/ and verify/ were already known: tables_combo.md, REVIEW_FINDINGS_20261115.json)
code: the server module itself (worktree box_refine_20261115, tracking_server/src/track/box_refine.py Refiner) is run frame by frame offline, so the offline scoring and the server use one reset rule (missing frames > 30, warp-aware 1.5-height jump, id hand-over IoU >= 0.5, per-id switch blend). Raw and tracker rows are the saved server-like rows (data/tracks, ref_lib.rows_of). The server's detection choice is copied: the matched detection when its IoU with the tracker row is >= 0.3, else the tracker row.
data: val-A = TMOT seq12, 18, 26, 48, 64 + DanceTrack 0023, 0045, 0066, 0086; val-B = TMOT val seq2, 17, 22, 47, 54, 66 + DanceTrack 0012, 0033, 0055, 0075, 0087, 0096, 0098, 0099 (PREREG_POS_REFINE_20261115 splits). Streams near, far, sw (switch every 2-6 s, track_run.py). Camera warp = data/gmc (server GMC). Time t = frame / fps (real seconds of the sequence).

size_mode.definition: per published id: centre x from the tracker row; y from the tracker row by the anchor; width / height = exp of One Euro over (log w, log h) of the size source; dt = t - t of the id's previous frame; before each step log sqrt|det H| of the camera warp since that id's previous frame is added to the state; state reset with the server rule; kept across detector switches; box_blend 0

anchors.top: box top edge and centre x = tracker row top edge and centre x (height grows / shrinks downward)

size_mode.grid_valA: src in {det (matched detection's size), trk (tracker row's size)} x mc_s in {0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 1.5, 3.0, 5.0} Hz x beta_s in {0, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0} (per log unit per s) x dcut = 1.0 Hz (Casiez default), for each anchor: 2 x 6 x 5 = 60 points per anchor, 120 in all

metrics: per row, against the GT-derived head-to-hip target (as verify/combo combo_lib): ce = centre error / target h (cap 2), aim = aim-point (top + 0.37 h) error / target h, lh = |log h / h_target|, d2a = aim second difference / target h (aim jitter = RMS), dh = |h_t - h_t-1| / target h on consecutive frames, da = aim-point step / target h, per-track max dh (median over tracks with >= 10 rows), size lag = sign(d log h_target) x log(h / h_target) for rows with |d log h_target| >= 0.03 per frame. NEW (corrected lag, CHECK B): lag against the CURRENT DETECTION along the target motion: along_det = ((centre - detection centre) . u) / target h and aim_det = ((aim - detection aim) . u) / target h, u = unit target motion this frame, by target speed bins 0-0.01 / 0.01-0.03 / 0.03-0.1 / > 0.1 heights per frame; size lag vs detection = sign(d log h_target) x log(h / h_detection). Events: track start = rows 1-2 and rows 1-4 of each server state segment; definition flip = combo_lib flip (raw/gt ratio regime 0.85 / 0.75, +-2 rows); switch frame, and the whole 1 s after a switch (the blend window and more): dh / da p99 and max.

selection_valA.pool: per dataset (TMOT, DanceTrack): streams near + far + sw pooled
selection_valA.objective: J = mean over the two datasets of (dh_p99 / tracker dh_p99 + per-track max dh median / tracker per-track max dh median) / 2; minimise
selection_valA.constraints: in BOTH datasets: (1) aim error <= 1.02 x tracker aim error; (2) aim jitter <= 1.02 x tracker aim jitter; (3) |log h| <= 1.02 x tracker |log h|; (4) size lag (vs target, fastest bin) >= tracker size lag - 0.01; (5) aim lag vs the detection in the fastest motion bin (> 0.1 h/frame) >= tracker's - 0.005 target heights
selection_valA.why_limits: 2 % relative margins and the 0.01 size-lag limit are the margins pre-registered for the v1 combinations (verify/combo/COMBO_RULES.json selection_a); 0.005 target heights is the v1 centre-lag limit of selection_b. They keep the gimbal aim (error, jitter, lag) at the tracker row's level, which is what the gimbal gets today.
selection_valA.ties: points within 0.005 of the best feasible J -> the largest mc_s (least smoothing), then the largest beta_s (least lag when the size changes fast), then src det
selection_valA.infeasible: if no point of an anchor is feasible, that anchor's pick is the point with the smallest largest relative constraint violation, marked infeasible
selection_valA.anchor: the anchor whose pick has the smaller J among the feasible picks; within 0.005 -> 'top' (the head top is the same in the whole-person and the head-to-hip definitions); if neither pick is feasible, the less violating one, and the size mode is reported as not meeting the val-A gates
selection_valA.server_value: the chosen (src, anchor, mc_s, beta_s, dcut) are written into box_refine.SIZE before val-B is run

valB_once.methods: raw detector, tracker row (today), euro (server EURO = v1 val-A One Euro), gru (server gru, models/track/box_refine_gru_tmotdance_20261115.npz), combo_a (gru, then One Euro on log size only: mc_s 5, beta_s 1, dcut 1, centre = gru centre, camera scale compensated, reset with the gru state), size (the val-A choice). All with box_blend 0.
valB_once.parts: nf = near + far streams pooled (no switches); sw = switch stream
valB_once.bootstrap: per sequence, 2000 draws, seed 0 (combo_lib / ref_eval helpers)
valB_once.pass_rules_size_vs_tracker: the size mode PASSES if in BOTH datasets: P1 nf dh p99 diff upper bound < 0; P2 nf per-track max dh (median) diff upper bound < 0; P3 nf aim error diff upper bound <= +0.003; P4 nf aim jitter^2 diff upper bound <= 0.04 x tracker aim jitter^2 (about +2 % RMS); P5 nf |log h| diff upper bound <= +0.005; P6 nf aim lag vs detection, fastest bin: diff lower bound >= -0.01; P7 sw: dh p99 over the 1 s after each switch: diff upper bound < 0
valB_once.reported_not_gated: size vs euro, gru, combo_a; centre error; events (start, flip, switch frame); lag vs target and vs detection in every speed bin; size lag
valB_once.deploy: a pass makes 'size' a candidate for the judge; the code default stays 'off' either way

device_recordings: no GT, report only (no gate): MEASURE_20261109_140236_2 (rec_person1, 1446 frames, 23.8 fps), MEASURE_20261110_165240 (287), MEASURE_20261110_170437 (107); detectors expE_v1_best (near) / C_control_v1_epoch2 (far) on the PC CPU (v2/scripts/dev_det.py), server GMC, server ByteTrack (track_run.run), streams near / far / sw; reference height = the tracker row height; height steps, aim steps, aim jitter, lag vs detection (detection motion over 3 frames), size lag vs detection; same methods as val-B
cpu: apply() on the PC, synthetic rows (with matched detections and a camera warp), 10 / 20 / 30 people, 350 frames, median ms per frame, best of 3 runs; modes off, size, euro, gru
